title: AS2 switch/case/try/catch/throw compiler support
description: The AS2 compiler is missing switch/case and try/catch/throw statement support. Add both: (1) switch(expr){case val: ... break; default: ...} — compiles to: evaluate expr, then for each case: ActionPush case_value, ActionEquals, ActionNot, ActionIf(skip_body); body; ActionJump(end); default falls through. Use backpatching for break; (2) try{...}catch(e){...}finally{...} — ActionTry opcode (0x8F): flags byte (hasCatch|hasFinally), catchVar string, trySize UI16, catchSize UI16, finallySize UI16, then try-body, catch-body, finally-body. All sizes must be pre-computed via sub-compiler buffers then patched in; (3) throw expr — ActionThrow opcode (0x2A): push expression then emit 0x2A. Add tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/switch-try.test.ts covering: switch with fall-through, switch with break, default case, try/catch, try/finally, try/catch/finally, throw, nested try. Only touches packages/core/src/as2/ — no authoring-ui changes.
